headline: Called by the Grave
title: Called by the Grave Explained | What It Does and How to Use It | Yu-Gi-Oh
video_script: This is Called by the Grave. What is it? It is a Quick-Play Spell Card. What does it do? Target one monster in your opponent's Graveyard and banish it. Until the end of the next turn, the effects of monsters with that same name are negated. How do you use it? Hold it to answer hand traps. When your opponent discards Ash Blossom to stop your search, chain Called by the Grave, banish Ash Blossom and negate its effect, and your combo goes on. Which card should I explain next? Comment below!
